entries.zh: 妒妇；妇人之间（妻与邻妇）的嫉妒
entries.en: envy between a woman and her (female) neighbor; a jealous woman/wife

entries.zh: 刺人目；使人眼红、惹人嫉妒（招人嫉恨）
entries.en: to prick the eye, be an eyesore; to stir up envy in others

entries.zh: 海口；海的出入口，港湾口、港口
entries.en: mouth of the sea; harbor entrance, seaport

entries.zh: 帖：字条、名帖、请帖等小笺；亦作计数单位（如一帖药）
entries.en: a written slip or card (label, notice, invitation); used as a counting unit (a dose, a tally)
entries.notes: 西语词头 Embolorio 非通行词形、义不可确考，据汉字「帖」（笺札、名帖，兼作计数单位）与 numeral（计数）推断释义。

entries.en: to wind round, to wrap around; to entangle

entries.zh: 裹（如裹殓、包殓状）〔汉字栏「裹/絮」存疑〕
entries.en: to wrap (as in shrouding a corpse)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「裹/絮」存疑、官话栏亦标 [疑]，据西语 como amortajando（如裹殓）释为裹（尸）。

entries.zh: 包密（包裹严实、裹紧封好）
entries.en: to wrap tightly, to seal up closely in wrapping

entries.zh: 包藏（裹而藏之、藏匿；亦指心怀——包藏祸心）
entries.en: to wrap up and hide, to conceal; to harbor (e.g. hidden ill intent)

entries.zh: 包暴〔义存疑：所指或为防暴晒而裹，或与毁坏义相关，无法定夺〕
entries.en: [uncertain] to wrap against the scorching sun, or to lay waste — Spanish headword doubtful (azolar/arsolar); sense undetermined
entries.notes: 西语词头带 [疑]（azolar/arsolar 两歧），「包暴」所指（防暴晒抑或毁坏）无法定夺。

entries.zh: 帕去（用布帕裹包、以帕裹住）〔M 栏首字残缺〕
entries.en: to wrap in a cloth, cover with a kerchief
entries.notes: M 栏首字标 [残]；西语 ompano 疑为 en paño 之讹，据汉字「帕去」与官话对音释为以布帕裹包。

entries.zh: 缠带（缠裹带子、绑扎成带）
entries.en: to wind round with a band; bandage, sash

entries.zh: 缠〔第二字「誕」疑讹（与官话对音不合），义为缠绕、缠裹〕
entries.en: to wind round, wrap round (second character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字第二字「誕」与官话对音不合，疑为「線」之讹，据西语 (emboluer) 释为缠绕义。

entries.en: to fall down drunk; to get drunk (emborracharse; of a drunkard)
to hold up / carry the shield (adarga, leather shield)

entries.zh: 漏斗（滤酒之漏）〔按：汉字栏作「酒樓」（酒馆），与西语 embudo（漏斗）相抵触，疑「漏/樓」形近致误，释义存疑〕
entries.en: funnel [embudo]; the Chinese column reads 酒樓 "tavern", which conflicts — possibly a misreading of 酒漏 "wine-funnel"; sense uncertain
entries.notes: 西语 embudo（漏斗）与汉字「酒樓」（酒馆）互相抵触，「漏／樓」形近易混，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 面是背非（当面一套、背后一套；两面三刀）
entries.en: to say yes to one's face and no behind one's back; two-faced, duplicitous
entries.notes: 西语词头标 [疑]（Embuuere/Embuelues），依短语 aqui diremos, ally otra 与汉字「面是背非」释为两面三刀。

entries.zh: 偷来偷去（到处偷摸、窜行窃盗）
entries.en: to steal here and there; one who roves about pilfering
entries.notes: 西语词头 emburtero 疑为 embustero 之讹，与汉字「偷来偷去」仅部分相合，以汉字侧为主释义。
